additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
After a charge we noticed DC contact temperatures exceeding
100°C. This error occured after a charger while no car was plugged
in. Thus we would like to kn ow if the issue is coming from a
defective PT1000 or if the charge caused this latent high
temparature. This issue was folowed by François Winckel, could you
please forward this ticket to him.
